chunks: 8 - Al-Husayn b. Ibrahim b. Natana (may Allah have mercy on him) narrated to us. He said: 'Ali b. Ibrahim narrated to us from his father from Muhammad b. Abi 'Umayr from 'Abdullah b. al-Fadl al-Hashimi from al-Sadiq Ja'far b. Muhammad from his father from his forefathers (peace be upon them). He said:

The Messenger of Allah (peace be upon him and his family) said: Blessed is he who lives a long life and beautifies his actions, for his ending will be good since his Lord, Mighty and Majestic, is pleased with him. And woe to he who lives a long life and commits evil, for his ending will be evil since his Lord, Mighty and Majestic, is discontented with him.

key_terms.طُوبَى: Tuba: blessed, fortunate; also the name of a tree in Paradise

ai.seo_question: What did the Prophet say about those who live long lives with good deeds vs evil deeds?
ai.summary: This hadith, transmitted through Imam al-Sadiq (AS) from the Prophet Muhammad (SAWW), contrasts two types of people: those blessed with long life who fill it with good deeds, whose ending is joyful because their Lord is pleased with them; and those with long life who fill it with evil deeds, whose ending is grievous because their Lord is angry with them. The teaching emphasizes that longevity alone is not a blessing - it is how one uses their time that determines their fate.
